# list.docker_network

<!-- Code generated by tools/genskill from the provider schema. DO NOT EDIT. -->

Kind: list-resource. Back to [SKILL.md](../SKILL.md).

Lists networks on the provider's Docker host as `docker_network` resources, for `terraform query` and bulk import. Filters map to the Engine API `GET /networks` filters; the predefined `bridge`, `host` and `none` networks are included unless `type = "custom"`.

List resources need Terraform >= 1.14 and live in `*.tfquery.hcl` files run
with `terraform query`. Arguments go inside the list block's `config` block.

## Usage

```terraform
# in a *.tfquery.hcl file; run: terraform query
list "docker_network" "<name>" {
  provider = docker
  # include_resource = true   # also return full resource objects
  # limit            = 100
  config {
    # arguments below
  }
}
```

## Arguments and attributes

| Name | Type | Status | Forces replacement | Sensitive | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `driver` | `string` | optional |  |  | Only networks using this driver, e.g. `bridge` or `overlay`. |
| `labels` | `map(string)` | optional |  |  | Only networks carrying every one of these labels. An empty value matches any value of that label key. |
| `name` | `string` | optional |  |  | Only networks whose name matches, using the Engine API `name` filter (substring or prefix match, as the daemon defines it). |
| `scope` | `string` | optional |  |  | Only networks of this scope: `local`, `swarm` or `global`. |
| `type` | `string` | optional |  |  | `custom` lists only user-defined networks, `builtin` only the predefined ones. |

## Example

```terraform
# Run with `terraform query` (Terraform 1.14+); add `-generate-config-out=imports.tf`
# to write import blocks and resource configuration for what is found.
provider "docker" {}

list "docker_network" "custom" {
  provider = docker

  config {
    type   = "custom"
    driver = "bridge"
  }
}
```
